$description: SearchResult and SearchResultGroup (platform/components/SearchResult, library wave 8, lane C): their component tokens. The thumbnail, the avatar, the group's heading and its link are Thumbnail's, Avatar's, SectionHeading's and Link's own.

search-result-group-gap.$description: SearchResultGroup: the space between the heading, the results and the link to all.

search-result-group-count-text.$description: SearchResultGroup: the count after the heading.

search-result-group-count-font-family.$description: SearchResultGroup: the count's font (a technical value: Reddit Mono).

search-result-group-count-margin-inline-.$description: SearchResultGroup: the space between the heading and its count.

search-result-gap.$description: SearchResult: the space between the thumbnail or avatar, the text and the actions.

search-result-padding-block.$description: SearchResult: the space above and under a result.

search-result-interactive-margin-inline.$description: SearchResult: a result that opens reaches past the list's edges by its inset, so only its fill does.

search-result-interactive-padding-inline.$description: SearchResult: the inset of a result that opens (room for its hover fill).

search-result-hover-background.$description: SearchResult: the fill of a result under the pointer.

search-result-selected-background.$description: SearchResult: the fill of the result whose preview is shown.

search-result-focus-outline-color.$description: SearchResult: the focus ring around a result whose link has keyboard focus.

search-result-focus-outline-offset.$description: SearchResult: the focus ring sits inside the row.

search-result-text-row-gap.$description: SearchResult: the space between the path, the title, the snippet and the meta.

search-result-path-text.$description: SearchResult: the path above the title.

search-result-path-gap.$description: SearchResult: the space around the chevrons of the path.

search-result-separator-size.$description: SearchResult: the chevron between the names of the path.

search-result-match-font-weight.$description: SearchResult: the words searched for, in the title and the snippet (bold, never a color).

search-result-snippet-text.$description: SearchResult: the words around the match.

search-result-meta-text.$description: SearchResult: the details under the snippet.

search-result-actions-gap.$description: SearchResult: the space between the actions.

search-result-actions-z-index.$description: SearchResult: the actions sit above the title's link, which covers the row.
